# Durga Healthcare

> Compassionate Home Care, Patient Support, and Nursing Services across India.

## Overview
Durga Healthcare provides professional and compassionate in-home healthcare services across India, including Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, and Chennai. 

- **Official Website**: https://durga-healthcare.vercel.app/
- **24/7 Helpline**: +91 85918 50947
- **Email**: govindkokare8751@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours**: 24/7 Round-the-Clock Support

## Key Services
- **Patient Care Assistance at Home**: Daily personal care, bathing, bed-to-chair mobility, hygiene, and feeding assistance for bedridden or post-surgery patients.
- **Elderly Care & Senior Companionship**: Dignified assistance, fall prevention, medication adherence, and compassionate care for elderly seniors living independently.
- **Professional Home Nursing Care**: Verified GNM/B.Sc registered nurses for injections, IV infusions, wound dressing, Foley catheter care, and vital signs monitoring.
- **Post-Hospitalization & Stroke Recovery**: Customized care coordination following discharge from hospital.
- **Physiotherapy at Home**: Rehabilitation for stroke, ortho recovery, mobility improvement, and joint replacements.
- **Medical Equipment Rental & Setup**: Oxygen concentrators, hospital beds, BiPAP/CPAP, and suction machines.
